quotes.author: Scott Hardy
quotes.text: My wife, Linda, and I went to The Front Bar Tuesday afternoon. We had the distinct pleasure of John E. being on duty. He was a great host and made us feel like regulars. Wednesday, we returned to find Barbara working. Her professionalism and kindness matched John E. We had delicious meals both evenings. I highly recommend the Lobster Dinner! As a bonus we met the owner and his daughter. Both wonderful and kind, as well as obviously hard-working. Robbie's isn't just a Bar or Restaurant or Marina... It's a well oiled organization! Thanks y'all.

quotes.author: Justin D Canada
quotes.text: What an awesome experience! You pay $5 to feed the tarpon and the sharks. Quite awesome. Just don't feed the pelicans. They're kind of jerks.
